clean.tl: They were big yams.

clean.tl: They will be big yams.

clean.tl: Well, this is another story about the crocodile.

clean.tl: The belly is all right, it's clean, but it has spikes on the back.

clean.tl: We figured this mother was sick.

clean.tl: They in the yard.

clean.tl: Well today we're lucky, you know.

clean.tx: "Yu got no bilij", imin tok lagijat.
clean.tl: "You've got no ashes", she said.

clean.tx: Ei imiyu, yu gadim eni mejik?
clean.tl: Hey Emu, do you have any magic?

clean.tx: Im kambek Sandei, im go Kananarra.
clean.tl: She'll come back on Sunday and will go to Kununurra.

clean.tx: Yu bin go Leichhardt.
clean.tl: You went to Leichhardt.

clean.tx: Al bin go Debi.
clean.tl: I went to Derby.

clean.tx: Na, ai nomo wanda gu la Top Kemp.
clean.tl: No, I don't want to go to the Top Camp.

clean.tx: Wan hi kambek from skul.
clean.tl: When he comes back from school.

clean.tx: Yu kam brom Risos Senta.
clean.tl: You come from the Resource Centre.

clean.tx: Mela bin kamap from Junjuwa.
clean.tl: We came from Junjuwa.

clean.tx: Yu kan getim langa thet lili rut.
clean.tl: You can't get amidst the lily roots.

clean.tx: Ai tjakam langa det sneik.
clean.tl: I throw it at the snake .

clean.tx: Pulemat from wota na!
clean.tl: Pull it out of the water now!

clean.tx: Dei bin dali mi thadmob gel ba gajimbat klos ba alabat biginini na.
clean.tl: They told me, those girls did, to get clothes for their children.

clean.tx: Im skrejim mijelb.
clean.tl: He scratches himself.

clean.tx: Buji yu rabim mijelb yu hatim.
clean.tl: If you rub yourself , you will be in pain.

clean.tx: Yu lafda wajim mijelp.
clean.tl: You have to wash yourself.

clean.tx: Tubala givit mijelb bekbon ij.
clean.tl: The two are turning the back to each other.

clean.tx: Maiti tubala bin graulim mijelb.
clean.tl: Maybe the two growled at each other.

clean.tx: Mela bin gula gija olawei.
clean.tl: We were telling off each other all the way.

clean.tx: Thet min yu bin get ben.
clean.tl: That means you got burned.

clean.tx: Detlat kulus bin git berndap.
clean.tl: Those clothes were burned .

clean.tx: Wot thet lijad we im jidan?
clean.tl: What's the lizard that stays?

clean.tx: Yu luk dijan iya klaud im meigimbat mijal.
clean.tl: You look at these clouds here forming .

clean.tx: Yunmi bin putim rais, we imin sidim?
clean.tl: Did you and I two put the rice that they sowed?

clean.tx: "A: sori" im reken.
clean.tl: "Ah sorry" he says.

clean.tx: Im sabi fait bek dijan.
clean.tl: He knows how to fight back.

clean.tx: Yu telim olabat hau yu wana seiv thet taka, fo yuself.
clean.tl: You tell them how you want to save that food for yourself.

clean.tx: Lukat, hi wana teikim dijey.
clean.tl: Look out, he wants to take it this way!

clean.tx: Ai wana go tharrei pleibat kad.
clean.tl: I want to go over there to play cards.

clean.tx: Hi don wantim olabat habem, pirdi deinjes.
clean.tl: He doesn't want them to have them, pretty dangerous.

clean.tx: I kan ranawei.
clean.tl: It cannot run away.

clean.tx: Nobodi neva putimbat mai haus.
clean.tl: Nobody ever builds my house.

clean.tx: Yu nomo gotim ninarlnguj, thet the Nangarla gotim, C.
clean.tl: You don't have ninarlnguj , it's Nangarla who has it, C.

clean.tx: Yu kan fiksim mi, enibodi kan fiksim mi.
clean.tl: You can't cure me, nobody can cure me.

clean.tx: Oni melabat na bin seif theya la Top Kemp.
clean.tl: only us were safe there at the Top Camp.

clean.tx: Thas tha wan gada kili wi. Im itha tharran ja o thet flu na.
clean.tl: That's the one will kill us.

clean.tx: Theya na yu bringim na!
clean.tl: There, you bring it!

clean.tx: Hajbanwan binij gigen from grog.
clean.tl: , the husband too stopped with the alcohol.

clean.tx: Ya gumilan igen mibala kolim.
clean.tl: Yes, we also call it gumilan .

clean.tx: ken tel yu thet stori tu.
clean.tl: can tell you that story too!

clean.tx: Eni piginini mani bin gaman bla mela?
clean.tl: Did any child endowment come for us?

clean.tx: Yu jabi wel na langguij.
clean.tl: You know the language well now.

clean.tx: Thei ken geta broken nek o am o leg.
clean.tl: They can get a broken neck or arm or leg.

clean.tx: Im jidan putim fut.
clean.tl: He is sitting and putting a toe .
